meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 处理 git 操作:把改动按目录和关注点拆成多个原子提交、做 rebase/squash 整理历史,还能查出某行代码是谁、何时改的。
howto.when: 当你提到 “commit”、“rebase” 等词,或问某行代码是谁写的、某个改动何时加入时触发,并按请求进入提交、变基、历史查找三种模式之一。

say.text: 把这几个文件的改动拆成多个原子提交
say.note: 先检测仓库提交风格,再按目录/关注点拆分

say.text: 把我最近几个提交 squash 成一个
say.note: 本地未推送的历史可被改写

say.text: 查一下这段代码是谁写的、什么时候加的
say.note: 走历史查找模式,用 blame/log 类手段

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude handles git work: splitting changes into multiple atomic commits, rebasing/squashing history, and finding who wrote a line and when a change was added.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “commit”, “rebase” and similar, or ask who wrote a line or when a change was added; it then enters commit, rebase, or history-search mode.

say_en.text: Split the changes in these files into several atomic commits
say_en.note: Detects repo style, then splits by directory/concern

say_en.text: Squash my recent commits into one
say_en.note: Local unpushed history can be rewritten

say_en.text: Find out who wrote this code and when it was added
